summary.text: Lisa Curtis is the Democratic candidate for the New Mexico House of Representatives, District 31, in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging incumbent Nicole Chavez (R).
An attorney, she previously served in the New Mexico State Senate representing District 21.

paragraphs.text: Curtis served in the New Mexico State Senate from 2012 to 2013, representing District 21, and during the 2011-2012 session was assigned to the Judiciary, Public Affairs and Elections committees.
She ran for re-election in 2012 and lost the general election to Republican Mark Moores, 56.6 percent to 43.4 percent.
